t: What he told them he could see
a: هَلْ تَرَوْنَ قِبْلَتِي هَا هُنَا فَوَاللَّهِ مَا يَخْفَى عَلَىَّ خُشُوعُكُمْ وَلاَ رُكُوعُكُمْ، إِنِّي لأَرَاكُمْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ ظَهْرِي
p: Hal tarawna qiblatī hāhunā. Fa-wa-Llāhi mā yakhfā ʿalayya khushūʿukum wa lā rukūʿukum, innī la-arākum min warāʾi ẓahrī
m: Do you think my face is only towards here? By Allah, neither your stillness nor your bowing is hidden from me. I see you from behind my back.
